testing_and_data_ids.rule: Every button, input, nav link, filter tab, card, and key text must have a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis or smooth scroll experience is active on page changes.
Maintain high accessibility contrast: Dark stone text (#1C1917) on Cream bg (#FDFBF7), white text on Forest Green (#122E22) and Night Blue (#0B132B).
Always mark placeholder photos clearly with 'photo à remplacer' overlay labels.
Always mark missing financial or phone details with visible '[à confirmer]' pill tags.
Include all required pages with smooth React Router navigation.
Use Sonner for toast notifications upon contact form submission.
